seo.title: Ingaruka Zacu — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Reba ingaruka z'ibikorwa bya Isôoko i Masoro, mu Rwanda — abaturage barenga 11,971 bagiye bafashwa.

hero.title: Ingaruka Zacu
hero.subtitle: Impinduka zigerwa mu baturage ba Masoro

t1.quote: Natangiye kuzigama RWF 200 gusa binyuze muri porogaramu. Uyu munsi, mfite iduka ryanjye mu Isoko rya Musizi. Isôoko yampaye icyizere cyo kwizera njyewe.

t2.quote: Ishuri ry'Icyongereza ryahinduye ubuzima bwanjye. Ubu nshobora kuvuga nta gutindigara kandi nkafasha abana b'ibanze b'umuryango wanjye imyitozo.

t3.quote: Mu gihe niganaga ubudozi, umushinga wa Tûuza Mubyeyi warebaga umwana wanjye. Ubu nshobora kubona amafaranga nkabona icyo gufatira umuryango wanjye.
